name: rokumio-plus
description: Native Roku client for Stremio addons and debrid streams

scripts.test: npm run check:proxy && node tests/run.js && node tools/mock-addon-server/server.test.js
scripts.clean: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); require('fs').rmSync('out', { recursive: true, force: true }); require('fs').rmSync('out-test', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.sim: npm run build && node tools/simulator/setup.js && python3 tools/simulator/server.py
